text:
alyssa: Hey team, customer (org_id=7432) reports their daily usage chart and CSV export show a missing day after the DST change in Europe/Berlin. They say the dashboard shows Mar 28 -> Mar 30 with no Mar 29 row in the export. Can someone triage?

jordan: Thanks Alyssa — can you paste a sample of the CSV they got? Also what timezone is set on their org?

alyssa: Pasted below (sanitized):

# export snippet:
date,token_count,req_count
2025-03-28,12045,312
2025-03-30,8000,210

Org timezone: Europe/Berlin (customer confirmed).

liam: Weird — that looks like a classic DST fold issue (spring forward -> 23-hour day) or our aggregation using UTC buckets. Which pipeline is producing the daily rollup? reporting-service v2.3.1?

alyssa: Export metadata from UI: reporting-service v2.3.1, export performed at 2025-03-31T09:10:11Z. Export format: daily_aggregates_by_org.

rana: This also affected their billing preview; they flagged an invoice mismatch. Need an ETA if data needs to be backfilled.

jordan: Can you repro locally with their org tz? Quick SQL I ran against the raw events shows the bug: we do date_trunc('day', generated_at) without timezone conversion. Patch suggestion: date_trunc('day', generated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') or better: (generated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' then date_trunc. Example I used: 

-- current buggy version
SELECT date_trunc('day', generated_at) as day, count(*) FROM event_stream WHERE org_id = 7432 GROUP BY 1;

-- suggested fix
SELECT date_trunc('day', (generated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') as day_local, count(*) FROM event_stream WHERE org_id = 7432 GROUP BY 1;

liam: Thanks. I pulled logs for reporting-service @ 2025-03-29 00:00:00Z -> 2025-03-30 00:00:00Z and see the job used server local tz (UTC) when bucketing. The transformer step didn't apply org timezone. That's on us.

export-bot: export completed: org=7432, export_id=exp_20250331_091011, file=s3://redwood-exports/7432/exp_20250331_091011.csv, rows=2

alyssa: Customer asked for a corrected export ASAP and to confirm whether historical days need reprocessing.

jordan: Short-term mitigation: I'll generate a corrected CSV using the fixed SQL and upload to the same export path with suffix -corrected. Long-term: add an explicit timezone-aware aggregation in reporting-service and add unit tests around DST transitions.

liam: I'll open a P0 internal ticket to backfill the last 90 days for any orgs not using UTC. Also scheduling a hotfix deploy to reporting-service that forces aggregation with org_tz in the transform stage.

rana: For billing impact, we should mark invoices from affected period as 'under review' and notify finance. I can prepare a customer-facing note once we have corrected CSV.

alyssa: I'll reply to the customer with a temporary corrected export and ETA for backfill. Quick question — do we have a list of orgs with non-UTC timezones so we can scope impact?

jordan: Yes, I can run a query: SELECT org_id FROM orgs WHERE timezone != 'UTC'. I'll attach results to the backfill ticket.

liam: FYI, putting a canary on the hotfix for 1% of requests first. Will monitor token_count deltas across DST boundary for any anomalies. :eyes:

alyssa: Thanks everyone. I'll post the customer update and link the corrected export here once uploaded. :thumbsup:
